description: Single-panel parity (actual vs predicted) scatter plot, titled "Actual vs Predicted Values". The x-axis is labelled "Actual Values/MPa" and the y-axis "Predicted Values/MPa"; both axes span 400 to 1800 MPa with major ticks every 200 MPa and no minor ticks. A red dashed 1:1 reference line runs diagonally from the lower-left corner to the upper-right corner of the plot area. Six orange circular markers with darker outlines represent the six test cases: one sits near 600 MPa on both axes just below the dashed line, a tight cluster of four lies between roughly 1100 and 1320 MPa also marginally below the line, and one isolated point falls near 1660 MPa, again slightly under the reference line. No numeric data labels, legend, error bars or scale bar are printed. Because every marker lies essentially on the identity line, the panel demonstrates that the GA-Extra trees model's predicted yield strength reproduces the measured yield strength of the collected medium-manganese low-density steel literature data over the whole ~600-1660 MPa range; the caption calls the panel a response diagram of model prediction.

observations.observation: The panel is a parity scatter plot titled 'Actual vs Predicted Values', with x-axis 'Actual Values/MPa' and y-axis 'Predicted Values/MPa', both ranging 400-1800 MPa with major ticks every 200 MPa.
A red dashed diagonal 1:1 reference line is drawn across the plot area from the 400 MPa lower-left corner toward the 1800 MPa upper-right corner.
Six orange circular markers are plotted; all of them lie marginally below the dashed identity line, i.e. predicted slightly under-predicts actual for every case.
Marker positions: one near 600 MPa on both axes, a cluster of four between roughly 1100 and 1320 MPa, and one isolated point near 1660 MPa; no numeric labels are printed on the markers.
The panel contains no legend, no error bars, no colour scale and no scale bar; only axis titles, tick numbers and the figure title are printed.
The caption identifies the panel as a 'Response diagram of model prediction'.
The citing text states a total of 6 groups of data were collected under 2 different compositions and different experimental conditions from existing studies [41,42], as listed in Table 5.
The citing text states the YS of the steel was predicted by the GA-Extra trees model, and the response diagram between predicted and real values is Fig. 16.
The citing text states the average error between model-predicted and measured values for the six test data groups is 1.84%.

The citing text states the average error of 1.84% is little changed from the 1.56% obtained in the earlier verification with actual experiments, which is used to argue excellent generalization and robustness.

The citing text states the four strengthening-mechanism contributions collected for this validation were solid solution strengthening, grain refinement strengthening, dislocation strengthening and Orovan strengthening.
The citing text notes the effect of the Orovan strengthening mechanism on the prepared Fe-0.25C-3Mn-2Al-0.4Si test steel was not obvious.
